_comment: Factory v5 — calendar/event entry kinds. Hypothesis: event-driven edges (FOMC drift, post-FOMC reversal, pre-FOMC accumulation) have a MECHANISM tied to monetary-policy uncertainty release that should be more regime-robust than technical edges. Tested against the same disciplined gates: 20y bootstrap PF CI >= 1.20 + period stability H1 vs H2.

specs.name: pre_fomc_5d
specs._thesis: Lucca-Moench: SPY drifts up 5 trading days before FOMC announcements (2015 NY Fed paper). Enter exactly 5 days before, exit at FOMC day close.

specs.name: pre_fomc_window_2to5d
specs._thesis: Enter ANY time we are 2-5 days before next FOMC. Position-management gates re-entry so we get one trade per cycle.

specs.name: post_fomc_drift_5d
specs._thesis: Post-announcement reaction continues for ~5 days after FOMC. Enter day after, exit 5 days later.

specs.name: pre_fomc_5d_trend_gated
specs._thesis: Only take pre-FOMC drift when in a bullish regime (close>SMA200).
